product_one_liner.value: CyberCube provides a cloud-based cyber-risk modeling and analytics platform for insurance organizations to quantify risk, support underwriting and insurance placement, and manage portfolio risk aggregation.

pricing_page.notes: No public pricing page or plans were found; commercial paths direct visitors to sales or a demo.

named_customers.notes: Both appear on the homepage logo wall, linked to announcements about adopting CyberCube products.

employee_band.notes: Available counts of 114 and 117 employees both fall within this band.

founded_year.notes: CyberCube traces its origins to a Symantec division in 2015; it launched as an independent company in 2018.

eng_blog.notes: Software engineer Emmanuel Thioux authored posts explaining CyberCube's document-sharing architecture and migration from Lambda functions to ECS.

public_docs.notes: The public help page directs users to resources inside their secured account rather than an open documentation library.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The board lists eight openings, none with a qualifying AI, ML or data-science title; data engineering and security research roles do not qualify.

model_provider.notes: Then-CEO Pascal Millaire said CyberCube had used OpenAI models and APIs since 2021; no specific model was named.

last_funding.notes: Tracxn records a $180 million Series D; CyberCube's October 1, 2025 announcement describes the financing as more than $180 million.

raised_18mo.notes: The October 2025 financing falls within the requested 18-month window.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: None of the eight listed openings is an SDR, BDR or account executive role; the sales opening is Senior Director, (Re)Insurance Sales.

launched_6mo.notes: The newest qualifying feature launch found was Regional Risk Transfer Benchmarking on May 5, 2026, before the window. September's I2T2 announcement concerned a research report/framework, not a software product feature.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: On February 9, 2026, CyberCube announced Chris Methven as CEO, succeeding Pascal Millaire, who became Senior Advisor.

crm_stack_signal.notes: The trust center lists HubSpot for CRM, customer support, sales operations and account management.
